def operation_lines(op, prefix=""):
    info = op["actor_info"]
    out = [f"{prefix}operation {op['id']}  {op['type']}",
           f"{prefix}edited by     {actor_label(info)}"]
    if op.get("snapshot") or op.get("commit"):
        out.append(f"{prefix}snapshot      {op.get('snapshot') or op['commit']}")
    if op.get("git_action"):
        action = op["git_action"]
        out.extend([f"{prefix}git action    {action['reflog']}",
                    f"{prefix}Git identity  {action['name']} <{action['email']}>",
                    f"{prefix}executor      {action['executor']}"])
    if op.get("session_id"): out.append(f"{prefix}session       {op['session_id']}")
    if op.get("turn"): out.append(f"{prefix}turn          {op['turn']}")
    if op.get("timestamp"): out.append(f"{prefix}timestamp     {op['timestamp']}")
    if "uncertain" in op.get("attribution_methods", []):
        out.append(f"{prefix}attribution   uncertain: overlapping or interrupted writes")
    if "observed" in op.get("attribution_methods", []):
        out.append(f"{prefix}attribution   observed repository state; author unknown")
    if op.get("target_op"): out.append(f"{prefix}undoes        operation {op['target_op']}")
    if op.get("target_commit"):
        verb = "restores" if op["type"] == "restore" else "undoes"

    for call in op["tool_calls"]:
        target = (call.get("input") or {}).get("file") or \
                 ", ".join((call.get("input") or {}).get("files") or [])

arguments.title: Group history by turn and preserve agents on uncertain edits
arguments.body:
Interleaved agent edits can prevent Git squashing, leaving individual tool calls as separate rows in `sun log` and `sun viz`. Group display rows by actor, session, turn, and branch while retaining underlying commits and per-operation snapshots. Terminal and HTML details expose constituent snapshots, and `-n` limits complete display entries. `sun data` continues to expose raw commits. Initialize missing turn state on the first tool call for subagents without a UserPromptSubmit hook; legacy `turn0` records remain separate.

Overlapping or failed paired tool calls now retain the observed agent instead of replacing it with `unknown`. Edit attribution stays `uncertain`; terminal/HTML operation details use “observed via,” and log/blame expose the uncertainty. Changes without an identified tool call retain unknown attribution. Existing stored events are not rewritten.

Validation: the initial 210-test regression run passed 209 tests; the remaining failure was an earlier version of a new test that wrote HTML inside its test repo. Corrected that fixture and all five focused checks passed. After the attribution change, all 30 reliability tests and three display regression tests passed. Coverage includes a read-only Codex shell overlapping apply_patch, concurrent writers, failed tools, raw-history preservation, and subagent turn boundaries. `git diff --check` passed.
